User Story: I want to give my dog a name when I first open the app so that I feel connected to my companion from the start
I want to photograph my prescription bottles and have the app read the labels so that I don't have to manually enter complex medication information
I want to hear my medication schedule explained aloud in plain language so that I understand what I'm taking and when
I want to invite my caregiver so that she can support me without having to call every day
I want my dog to send me a friendly notification when it's time to take my pills so that I remember without feeling nagged
I want to take a photo of my pills as proof and see my dog celebrate so that taking medication feels rewarding
I want my dog to wait patiently if I miss a dose and gently remind me after 30 minutes so that I feel supported, not shamed
I want to see a dashboard showing my medication history, upcoming doses, and health readings so that I have a complete view of my health management
I want to start a GPS-tracked walk with my dog so that staying active feels like caring for my companion
As a caregiver, I want to receive gentle positive updates about my parent's adherence so that I know they're doing well without intruding
As a caregiver, I want to be notified softly when my parent misses a dose so that I can offer support without causing alarm
I want to use core medication reminders and photo verification for free so that I can try the app without financial commitment
I want to log my blood pressure and glucose readings throughout the day so that I can track my health in one place
I want to earn location-based collectibles when I complete walks so that exploring my neighborhood feels fun and rewarding?
I want my dog to learn new tricks after I maintain a weekly adherence streak so that I feel proud of my consistency?
I want my dog's world to evolve from a flat to a garden to a kampung as I progress so that I see my long-term commitment reflected visually
As a caregiver, I want to view my parent's adherence history on a dashboard so that I can understand patterns and discuss them during doctor visits
I want to upgrade to premium for multiple caregiver accounts and unlimited health readings so that my whole family can stay connected and I can track more health data
I want my dog to react playfully when I take the bus instead of walking so that I'm encouraged without being scolded
I want to celebrate with a festival day when I complete my annual health screening so that major health milestones feel special
I want premium to include advanced dog customization and detailed health reports so that I can personalize my experience and share comprehensive data with my doctor
